nodes.label: Galedra as an epistemic ledger (skill definition)
nodes.rationale: The one-paragraph definition every connected assistant is given: a signed, append-only record of claims, the evidence bearing on them, where that evidence came from, and what has happened to it since. Explicitly not a source of truth — it gives traceable reasons for believing or doubting a claim. The negation is stated first so an assistant does not present a score as a verdict.

nodes.label: The three things people use Galedra for
nodes.rationale: Break something seen on social media into checkable claims and record it, so a link to the record is shared instead of a rumour; send someone a claim link so they see the reasons rather than take anyone's word; and help the project by checking claims already recorded. An assistant asked what Galedra is for must say these three in plain words before listing tools — capability lists describe the API, not the point.

nodes.label: The working rules live on the server, not in the skill
nodes.rationale: A skill is installed once and never re-read, so a rule written in it is frozen at whatever it said on installation day and correcting it would mean asking every user to reinstall — not realistic in production. The file therefore deliberately omits the operational rules and points at the server instead, so a change reaches a connected assistant on its next call.

nodes.label: guidance object on every MCP tool result
nodes.rationale: Every MCP tool result carries a version, a topic and the text of the rules for the work being done. Nothing caches a tool result, which is exactly why this channel is chosen: it is always current, and where it differs from the installed skill it wins.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/guidance (non-MCP hosts)
nodes.rationale: REST hosts fetch the same rules at the start of a Galedra task, optionally narrowed with ?topic=. Assistants are told to fetch again in a later session rather than relying on memory, because a remembered rule has the same staleness problem as an installed one.

nodes.label: Guidance topics: check, outline, inference, work, correct
nodes.rationale: check records what was read; outline handles a source too large for one check; inference records a reasoning step; work answers open tasks; correct revises what is recorded. The five topics partition the assistant's whole surface onto the ledger.

nodes.label: The `galedra:` trigger
nodes.rationale: A message that is just `galedra:` followed by text — a pasted post, a sentence about to be shared — means check this before I share it, record the whole statement, and end with the share line. A single prefix stands in for the whole instruction so the user never has to describe the workflow.

nodes.label: Search first (search_claims before recording)
nodes.rationale: Call search_claims (or GET /api/v1/claims?q=) with the key words; if an accepted claim already matches, report its card and URL and stop unless there is new evidence to add. Prevents the ledger accumulating duplicate claims, since only an accepted, reversible MERGE_CLAIMS can join them afterwards.

nodes.label: Your own reasoning is never evidence
nodes.rationale: Only quoted passages are evidence. Never write a statement that cannot be pointed to in a source, and never invent a source, a quotation or a hash. Kept in the frozen skill file rather than only on the wire because an assistant could break it before its first call, and breaking it damages the record itself rather than merely producing a worse answer.

nodes.label: Never record claims about identifiable private individuals
nodes.rationale: A public figure in their public role is fair; a person they mention is not. The second of the two rules repeated locally, for the same reason: an append-only public log makes this kind of mistake permanent.

nodes.label: Every write is signed and open to audit
nodes.rationale: A write is attributed to the assistant as an agent acting for the user, or to an anonymous key, and left permanently open to audit in the public log. Stated to the assistant up front so the consequence of a careless contribution is known before it makes one.
